subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook mappings support automatic post-failure fallback delivery, and if so should the public contract be ordered `fallbackChannels`, reuse cron `failureDestination`, or keep hooks single-target?
rationale: This adds public config and cross-channel delivery behavior, and repository policy treats fallback/config additions as compatibility- and product-sensitive.

options.title: Add ordered fallbackChannels
options.body: Add a typed ordered fallback list to hook mappings and attempt alternates only after a real primary delivery failure, with docs and tests for all-targets-failed behavior.

options.title: Reuse failureDestination
options.body: Model hook fallback through the existing cron failure-destination abstraction if maintainers want one shared failure-routing concept.

options.title: Keep single-target hooks
options.body: Keep hook mappings single-target and document `channel: "last"`, `bestEffortDeliver`, and `failureDestination` as the supported recovery paths.

recommendation.title: Add ordered fallbackChannels
recommendation.body: Add a typed ordered fallback list to hook mappings and attempt alternates only after a real primary delivery failure, with docs and tests for all-targets-failed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current hook-surface provenance in the available checkout and previously reviewed this product question as still open.
